versos.grego: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἦν ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων, καὶ ἀνέβη Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

controles.web: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Depois disto houve uma festa dos judeus, e subiu Jesus para Jerusalém.

versos.grego: Ἔστιν δὲ ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐπὶ τῇ προβατικῇ κολυμβήθρα, ἡ ἐπιλεγομένη Ἑβραϊστὶ Βηθζαθά, πέντε στοὰς ἔχουσα.

controles.web: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
controles.kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
controles.livre: E há em Jerusalém à porta das ovelhas um tanque, que em hebraico se chama Betesda, que tem cinco entradas cobertas.

versos.grego: ἐν ταύταις κατέκειτο πλῆθος τῶν ἀσθενούντων, τυφλῶν, χωλῶν, ξηρῶν(, ἐκδεχομένων τὴν τοῦ ὕδατος κίνησιν.

controles.web: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;
controles.kjv: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
controles.livre: Nestes jazia grande multidão de enfermos, cegos, mancos, e de corpo ressecado«, aguardando o movimento da água.

versos.grego: ἄγγελος γὰρ κατὰ καιρὸν κατέβαινεν ἐν τῇ κολυμβήθρᾳ καὶ ἐτάρασσε τὸ ὕδωρ· ὁ οὖν πρῶτος ἐμβὰς μετὰ τὴν ταραχὴν τοῦ ὕδατος ὑγιὴς ἐγίνετο, ᾧ δήποτε κατείχετο νοσήματι).

controles.web: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool, and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.
controles.kjv: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
controles.livre: Porque um anjo descia de vez em quando ao tanque, e agitava a água; e o primeiro que descia nele, depois do movimento da água, sarava de qualquer enfermidade que tivesse.»

versos.grego: ἦν δέ τις ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖ τριάκοντα καὶ ὀκτὼ ἔτη ἔχων ἐν τῇ ἀσθενείᾳ αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: A certain man was there, who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
controles.kjv: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
controles.livre: E estava ali um certo homem, que havia trinta e oito anos que estava enfermo.

versos.grego: τοῦτον ἰδὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς κατακείμενον, καὶ γνοὺς ὅτι πολὺν ἤδη χρόνον ἔχει, λέγει αὐτῷ Θέλεις ὑγιὴς γενέσθαι;

controles.web: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”
controles.kjv: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
controles.livre: Vendo Jesus a este deitado, e sabendo, que já havia muito tempo que ali jazia, disse-lhe: Queres sarar?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ ὁ ἀσθενῶν Κύριε, ἄνθρωπον οὐκ ἔχω, ἵνα ὅταν ταραχθῇ τὸ ὕδωρ βάλῃ με εἰς τὴν κολυμβήθραν· ἐν ᾧ δὲ ἔρχομαι ἐγὼ, ἄλλος πρὸ ἐμοῦ καταβαίνει.

controles.web: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”
controles.kjv: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
controles.livre: Respondeu-lhe o enfermo: Senhor, não tenho homem algum para que, quando a água se agita, me ponha no tanque; e enquanto eu venho, outro desce antes de mim.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἔγειρε ἆρον τὸν κράβαττόν σου καὶ περιπάτει.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe Jesus: Levanta-te, toma teu leito, e anda.

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθέως ἐγένετο ὑγιὴς ὁ ἄνθρωπος, καὶ ἦρεν τὸν κράβαττον αὐτοῦ καὶ περιεπάτει. Ἦν δὲ σάββατον ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ.

controles.web: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked.   Now it was the Sabbath on that day.
controles.kjv: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
controles.livre: E logo aquele homem sarou; e tomou seu leito, e andou. E era Sábado aquele dia.

versos.grego: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τῷ τεθεραπευμένῳ Σάββατόν ἐστιν, καὶ οὐκ ἔξεστίν σοι ἆραι τὸν κράβαττον.

controles.web: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
controles.kjv: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
controles.livre: Disseram pois os judeus para aquele que fora curado: É Sábado, não te é lícito levar o leito.

versos.grego: ὃς δὲ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς Ὁ ποιήσας με ὑγιῆ, ἐκεῖνός μοι εἶπεν Ἆρον τὸν κράβαττόν σου καὶ περιπάτει.

controles.web: He answered them, “He who made me well, the same said to me, ‘Take up your mat, and walk.’”
controles.kjv: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
controles.livre: Respondeu-lhes ele: Aquele que me curou, esse me disse: Toma teu leito, e anda.

versos.grego: ἠρώτησαν αὐτόν Τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ εἰπών σοι Ἆρον καὶ περιπάτει;

controles.web: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat, and walk’?”
controles.kjv: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
controles.livre: Perguntaram-lhe pois: Quem é o homem que te disse: Toma teu leito e anda?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἰαθεὶς οὐκ ᾔδει τίς ἐστιν· ὁ γὰρ Ἰησοῦς ἐξένευσεν ὄχλου ὄντος ἐν τῷ τόπῳ.

controles.web: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
controles.kjv: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
controles.livre: E o que fora curado, não sabia quem o era, porque Jesus se havia retirado, porque naquele lugar havia uma grande multidão.

versos.grego: Μετὰ ταῦτα εὑρίσκει αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἴδε ὑγιὴς γέγονας· μηκέτι ἁμάρτανε, ἵνα μὴ χεῖρόν σοί τι γένηται.

controles.web: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
controles.kjv: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
controles.livre: Depois Jesus achou-o no Templo, e disse-lhe: Eis que já estás são; não peques mais, para que não te suceda alguma coisa pior.

versos.grego: ἀπῆλθεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ ποιήσας αὐτὸν ὑγιῆ.

controles.web: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
controles.kjv: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
controles.livre: Aquele homem foi anunciar aos judeus que Jesus era o que o curara.

versos.grego: καὶ διὰ τοῦτο ἐδίωκον οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τὸν Ἰησοῦν, ὅτι ταῦτα ἐποίει ἐν σαββάτῳ.

controles.web: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
controles.kjv: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
controles.livre: E por isso os judeus perseguiam Jesus,  porque ele fazia estas coisas no sábado.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀπεκρίνατο αὐτοῖς Ὁ Πατήρ μου ἕως ἄρτι ἐργάζεται, κἀγὼ ἐργάζομαι·

controles.web: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
controles.kjv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Meu Pai até agora trabalha, e eu também trabalho.

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο οὖν μᾶλλον ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀποκτεῖναι, ὅτι οὐ μόνον ἔλυεν τὸ σάββατον, ἀλλὰ καὶ Πατέρα ἴδιον ἔλεγεν τὸν Θεόν, ἴσον ἑαυτὸν ποιῶν τῷ Θεῷ.

controles.web: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
controles.kjv: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
controles.livre: Por isto ainda mais procuravam os Judeus matá-lo, porque não só quebrava o sábado, mas também dizia que Deus era seu próprio Pai, fazendo-se igual a Deus.

versos.grego: Ἀπεκρίνατο οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐ δύναται ὁ Υἱὸς ποιεῖν ἀφ’ ἑαυτοῦ οὐδὲν, ἂν μή τι βλέπῃ τὸν Πατέρα ποιοῦντα· ἃ γὰρ ἂν ἐκεῖνος ποιῇ, ταῦτα καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς ὁμοίως ποιεῖ.

controles.web: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
controles.kjv: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
controles.livre: Respondeu pois Jesus, e disse-lhes: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que não pode o Filho fazer coisa alguma de si mesmo, a não ser aquilo que ele veja o Pai fazer; porque todas as coisas que ele faz, semelhantemente o Filho também as faz.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ Πατὴρ φιλεῖ τὸν Υἱὸν καὶ πάντα δείκνυσιν αὐτῷ ἃ αὐτὸς ποιεῖ, καὶ μείζονα τούτων δείξει αὐτῷ ἔργα, ἵνα ὑμεῖς θαυμάζητε.

controles.web: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
controles.kjv: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
controles.livre: Porque o Pai ama ao Filho, e todas as coisas que faz lhe mostra; e maiores obras que estas lhe mostrará, para que vós vos maravilheis.

versos.grego: ὥσπερ γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐγείρει τοὺς νεκροὺς καὶ ζωοποιεῖ, οὕτως καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς οὓς θέλει ζωοποιεῖ.

controles.web: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
controles.kjv: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
controles.livre: Porque como o Pai aos mortos ressuscita e vivifica, assim também o Filho aos que quer vivifica.

versos.grego: οὐδὲ γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ κρίνει οὐδένα, ἀλλὰ τὴν κρίσιν πᾶσαν δέδωκεν τῷ Υἱῷ,

controles.web: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
controles.kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
controles.livre: Porque também o Pai a ninguém julga, mas todo o juízo deu ao Filho,

versos.grego: ἵνα πάντες τιμῶσι τὸν Υἱὸν καθὼς τιμῶσι τὸν Πατέρα. ὁ μὴ τιμῶν τὸν Υἱὸν οὐ τιμᾷ τὸν Πατέρα τὸν πέμψαντα αὐτόν.

controles.web: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
controles.kjv: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
controles.livre: Para que todos honrem ao Filho, como honram ao Pai. Quem não honra ao Filho, não honra ao Pai que o enviou.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὁ τὸν λόγον μου ἀκούων καὶ πιστεύων τῷ πέμψαντί με ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον, καὶ εἰς κρίσιν οὐκ ἔρχεται ἀλλὰ μεταβέβηκεν ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου εἰς τὴν ζωήν.

controles.web: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word, and believes him who sent me, has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
controles.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
controles.livre: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que quem ouve minha palavra, e crê ao que me enviou, tem vida eterna, e não virá em condenação, mas passou da morte para a vida.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ νῦν ἐστιν ὅτε οἱ νεκροὶ ἀκούσουσιν τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀκούσαντες ζήσουσιν.

controles.web: Most certainly, I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
controles.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
controles.livre: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que a hora vem, e agora é, quando os mortos ouvirão a voz do Filho de Deus, e aos que ao ouvirem, viverão.

versos.grego: ὥσπερ γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ ἔχει ζωὴν ἐν ἑαυτῷ, οὕτως καὶ τῷ Υἱῷ ἔδωκεν ζωὴν ἔχειν ἐν ἑαυτῷ.

controles.web: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
controles.kjv: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
controles.livre: Porque como o Pai tem vida em si mesmo, assim deu também ao Filho que tivesse vida em si mesmo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ κρίσιν ποιεῖν, ὅτι Υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ἐστίν.

controles.web: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
controles.kjv: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
controles.livre: E deu-lhe poder, para fazer juízo, porque é o Filho do homem.

versos.grego: μὴ θαυμάζετε τοῦτο, ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα ἐν ᾗ πάντες οἱ ἐν τοῖς μνημείοις ἀκούσουσιν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ

controles.web: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes, in which all that are in the tombs will hear his voice,
controles.kjv: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
controles.livre: Não vos maravilheis disto; porque a hora vem, em que todos os que estão nos sepulcros ouvirão sua voz.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐκπορεύσονται οἱ τὰ ἀγαθὰ ποιήσαντες εἰς ἀνάστασιν ζωῆς, οἱ τὰ φαῦλα πράξαντες εἰς ἀνάστασιν κρίσεως.

controles.web: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
controles.kjv: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
controles.livre: E sairão os que fizeram bem, para a ressurreição de vida; e os que fizeram mal, à ressurreição de condenação.

versos.grego: Οὐ δύναμαι ἐγὼ ποιεῖν ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐδέν· καθὼς ἀκούω κρίνω, καὶ ἡ κρίσις ἡ ἐμὴ δικαία ἐστίν, ὅτι οὐ ζητῶ τὸ θέλημα τὸ ἐμὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με.

controles.web: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is righteous; because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
controles.kjv: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
controles.livre: Não posso eu de mim mesmo fazer alguma coisa. Como ouço, assim julgo; e meu juízo é justo; porque não busco minha vontade, mas a vontade do Pai que me enviou.

versos.grego: Ἐὰν ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ, ἡ μαρτυρία μου οὐκ ἔστιν ἀληθής·

controles.web: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
controles.kjv: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
controles.livre: Se eu testemunho de mim mesmo, meu testemunho não é verdadeiro.

versos.grego: ἄλλος ἐστὶν ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ ἐμοῦ, καὶ οἶδα ὅτι ἀληθής ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία ἣν μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ.

controles.web: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
controles.kjv: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
controles.livre: Outro há que testemunha de mim, e sei que o testemunho, que testemunha de mim, é verdadeiro.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς ἀπεστάλκατε πρὸς Ἰωάνην, καὶ μεμαρτύρηκεν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ·

controles.web: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
controles.kjv: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
controles.livre: Vós enviastes mensageiros a João, e ele deu testemunho à verdade.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ παρὰ ἀνθρώπου τὴν μαρτυρίαν λαμβάνω, ἀλλὰ ταῦτα λέγω ἵνα ὑμεῖς σωθῆτε.

controles.web: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
controles.kjv: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
controles.livre: Porém eu não recebo testemunho humano; mas digo isto para que sejais salvos.

versos.grego: ἐκεῖνος ἦν ὁ λύχνος ὁ καιόμενος καὶ φαίνων, ὑμεῖς δὲ ἠθελήσατε ἀγαλλιαθῆναι πρὸς ὥραν ἐν τῷ φωτὶ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
controles.kjv: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
controles.livre: Ele era uma lâmpada ardente e brilhante; e vós quisestes por um pouco de tempo alegrar em sua luz.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ δὲ ἔχω τὴν μαρτυρίαν μείζω τοῦ Ἰωάνου· τὰ γὰρ ἔργα ἃ δέδωκέν μοι ὁ Πατὴρ ἵνα τελειώσω αὐτά, αὐτὰ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιῶ, μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὅτι ὁ Πατήρ με ἀπέσταλκεν.

controles.web: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
controles.kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
controles.livre: Mas eu tenho maior testemunho que o de João; porque as obras que o Pai me deu que cumprisse, as mesmas obras que eu faço, testemunham de mim que o Pai me enviou.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ πέμψας με Πατὴρ, ἐκεῖνος μεμαρτύρηκεν περὶ ἐμοῦ. οὔτε φωνὴν αὐτοῦ πώποτε ἀκηκόατε οὔτε εἶδος αὐτοῦ ἑωράκατε,

controles.web: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
controles.kjv: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
controles.livre: E o Pai que me enviou, ele mesmo testemunhou de mim. Nunca ouvistes sua voz, nem vistes sua aparência.

versos.grego: καὶ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔχετε ἐν ὑμῖν μένοντα, ὅτι ὃν ἀπέστειλεν ἐκεῖνος, τούτῳ ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετε.

controles.web: You don’t have his word living in you; because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
controles.kjv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
controles.livre: E não tendes sua palavra permanecendo em vós; porque ao que ele enviou, a esse vós não credes.

versos.grego: ἐραυνᾶτε τὰς γραφάς, ὅτι ὑμεῖς δοκεῖτε ἐν αὐταῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἔχειν· καὶ ἐκεῖναί εἰσιν αἱ μαρτυροῦσαι περὶ ἐμοῦ·

controles.web: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
controles.kjv: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
controles.livre: Investigai as Escrituras; porque vós pensais que nelas tendes a vida eterna, e elas são as que de mim testemunham.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐ θέλετε ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἵνα ζωὴν ἔχητε.

controles.web: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
controles.kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
controles.livre: E não quereis vir a mim, para que tenhais vida.

versos.grego: Δόξαν παρὰ ἀνθρώπων οὐ λαμβάνω,

controles.web: I don’t receive glory from men.
controles.kjv: I receive not honour from men.
controles.livre: Não recebo honra humana.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ἔγνωκα ὑμᾶς ὅτι τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐκ ἔχετε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.

controles.web: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
controles.kjv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
controles.livre: Mas eu bem vos conheço que não tendes o amor de Deus em vós mesmos.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ ἐλήλυθα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Πατρός μου, καὶ οὐ λαμβάνετέ με· ἐὰν ἄλλος ἔλθῃ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τῷ ἰδίῳ, ἐκεῖνον λήμψεσθε.

controles.web: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
controles.kjv: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
controles.livre: Eu vim em nome de meu Pai, e vós não me aceitais; se outro vier em seu próprio nome, a esse aceitareis.

versos.grego: πῶς δύνασθε ὑμεῖς πιστεῦσαι, δόξαν παρὰ ἀλλήλων λαμβάνοντες, καὶ τὴν δόξαν τὴν παρὰ τοῦ μόνου Θεοῦ οὐ ζητεῖτε;

controles.web: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
controles.kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
controles.livre: Como podeis vós crer, se tomais honra uns dos outros, e não buscais a honra que vem somente de Deus?

versos.grego: μὴ δοκεῖτε ὅτι ἐγὼ κατηγορήσω ὑμῶν πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα· ἔστιν ὁ κατηγορῶν ὑμῶν Μωϋσῆς, εἰς ὃν ὑμεῖς ἠλπίκατε.

controles.web: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
controles.kjv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
controles.livre: Não penseis que eu vos tenha de acusar para com o Pai; o que vos acusa é Moisés, em quem vós esperais.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ ἐπιστεύετε Μωϋσεῖ, ἐπιστεύετε ἂν ἐμοί· περὶ γὰρ ἐμοῦ ἐκεῖνος ἔγραψεν.

controles.web: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
controles.kjv: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
controles.livre: Porque se vós crêsseis em Moisés, também a mim me creríeis; porque de mim ele escreveu.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ τοῖς ἐκείνου γράμμασιν οὐ πιστεύετε, πῶς τοῖς ἐμοῖς ῥήμασιν πιστεύσετε;

controles.web: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
controles.kjv: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
controles.livre: Mas se não credes em seus escritos, como crereis em minhas palavras?
